_comment: Minimal trip detail response for OUTSTATION trips. Only fields consumed by the frontend detail view are included. Fields omitted vs local: package (not applicable), rate_per_min (charged per-km, not per-minute). Fields added vs local: end_datetime (return date), total_days, rate_per_km, included_kms, driver_allowance (shown separately), hops (optional intermediate stops), is_interstate, luggage counts (num_large_suitcases, num_carryons, num_backpacks, num_other_bags). Note: price_breakdown includes driver_allowance and permit_fee for interstate trips.

If you cancel between 24–48 hours before trip start, 50% of the paid amount will be refunded.
No refund if cancelled within 24 hours of trip start.
